AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Aircheck drafts short-form talking-head broadcast scripts, queues cloud video renders using an enrolled personal voice and presenter photo, and lists finished clips. Operational Patterns: - Call 'createScriptDraft' first to obtain a scriptId before calling 'renderClipWithSavedPhoto'. - Call 'listReadyClips' to inspect completed broadcasts without initiating a render. Constraints: - Supported target durations are 15, 30, 45, and 60 seconds. - Cloud rendering requires an enrolled voice_id, head_model_id, and at least one saved presenter photo.
